subject: Marketplace packaging: SKU family consolidation and channel credit cadence
messages:
From: Elena Park <procurement@nimblesoft.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Team <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging + channel credit cadence for NimbleSoft private offer

Jordan — thanks for the demo yesterday. Our procurement team is ready to move to a private offer, but we need clarity on two things before we can sign:

1) SKU packaging: we want a simpler SKU family rather than 15 metered SKUs — can Redwood propose a condensed mapping (e.g., Standard, Pro, Enterprise) that preserves our usage tiers?

2) Channel credit cadence: Nimble's reseller processes require predictable passback timing. Will credits be netted monthly or quarterly from marketplace settlements? We need to align to our bookkeeping.

I've attached our 12-month usage forecast for reference.

Attachments: nimble_usage_forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Elena Park
Director, Procurement — NimbleSoft
procurement@nimblesoft.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <procurement@nimblesoft.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging + channel credit cadence for NimbleSoft private offer

Elena — really appreciate the clear asks and the forecast. Happy to simplify SKUs and lock a credit cadence that works for your finance team. Proposed next steps: 

- Quick internal alignment on our side (Ben + Irene) to pick an SKU consolidation that maps to your forecast.
- I'll share two packaging options (3-tier and a usage-bucketed version) by tomorrow EOD.
- Proposal will include the channel passback timing (monthly netting is our preference for faster reconciliation, but we can do quarterly if you need).

Can you confirm who from Nimble handles Marketplace billing? I'll include them on the doc.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Draft SKU consolidation + channel credit options for NimbleSoft

Team — forwarding Elena's ask. Quick draft thoughts (see attached PDF for mapping):

Option A — Tiered families (recommended for procurement simplicity)
- Standard: up to 50k tokens/mo (basic inference)
- Pro: 50k–500k tokens/mo (batch + streaming optimizations)
- Enterprise: 500k+ tokens/mo (dedicated inference pool)

Option B — Usage buckets (more granular; increases SKU count but aligns price steps)

Channel credit cadence (two options):
- Monthly netting: Redwood consolidates marketplace settlement each month and issues reseller passback during the next settlement window. Pros: faster cashflow alignment; Cons: requires monthly reconciliation on Nimble side.
- Quarterly netting: Redwood aggregates credits quarterly and issues a single passback. Pros: simpler for low-volume resellers; Cons: lag in crediting.

Pricing guardrails to preserve channel economics:
- Target reseller netback: ~18% after marketplace fees (we need to hold list-price floor to preserve this).
- Early-adopter promotional credit: one-time 10% credit applied in month 1 (if Nimble signs within 30 days).
- Marketing coop: optional 3% discretionary fund (paid as rebate).

Thoughts? If we keep the 18% netback we can avoid margin compression for channel partners. I attached a short proposal PDF with SKU mapping and example math.

Attachments: sku_consolidation_proposal.pdf

-Jordan
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Draft SKU consolidation + channel credit options for NimbleSoft

Agree with Jordan's recommended Option A. A few constraints from marketplace ops and channel comp: 

- We need to keep minimum list-price floors per tier so reseller netback doesn't fall below 18% after AWS marketplace fees (~12%) and our reserved channel fee.
- For Nimble's size, monthly netting is feasible, but Ops needs a signed PO at least 7 business days before the end of the month to include in that month's settlement run. If not, credits fall to the next month.
- Early-adopter 10% credit is acceptable, but structure it as a one-time invoice credit (so it doesn't impact committed revenue recognition).
- Add a 30-day reporting SLA: Redwood will provide a monthly passback report with transaction-level detail (invoice ids, marketplace settlement ids).

If legal asks about tax treatment, we should default to netting credits and include a clause that taxes are responsibility of the reseller unless otherwise required by jurisdiction — Irene, please prepare a short paragraph we can include in the quote.

-Ben
Head of Marketplace Sales
From: Elena Park <procurement@nimblesoft.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Team <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging + channel credit cadence for NimbleSoft private offer

Thanks Jordan & team — that all sounds reasonable. A couple of quick items before we finalize: 

1) Confirmed: Nimble prefers monthly netting (we have the ops head to reconcile monthly). Please ensure PO date cutoffs are explicit in the quote.
2) Please send final pricing with list-price floors per tier and show sample math for the 18% reseller netback after marketplace fees.
3) Legal has a couple of redlines on the tax paragraph — I've attached their markups.

If we can get a final quote + DocuSign today, procurement will route for signature tomorrow.

Attachments: legal_terms_redlines.pdf

—Elena
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <procurement@nimblesoft.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, AWS Marketplace Team <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Marketplace packaging: SKU family consolidation and channel credit cadence

Elena — attaching the final quote and DocuSign link. Summary of the agreed points (per internal Ops constraints):

- Packaging: Option A (Standard / Pro / Enterprise) — list-price floors included in quote.
- Channel credit cadence: Monthly netting. To hit the month-end settlement, PO must be received 7 business days prior to month close.
- Reseller economics: We show sample math in the quote demonstrating ~18% netback after marketplace fees.
- Early-adopter credit: One-time 10% invoice credit applied in month 1.
- Reporting: Monthly passback report (30-day SLA).
- Tax: Irene drafted a short clause addressing jurisdictional treatment; legal redlines noted — Ben/Irene to finalize if legal requires further edits.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/initiator/ABC-7890
Attachments: final_quote_nimble_20260525.pdf

Please confirm and we will instruct AWS Marketplace to publish the private offer upon signature.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: final_quote_nimble_20260525.pdf
